utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I can help confirm the time, tools, and parts for the repair drive. Sunday at the community center is set, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — Sunday at the community center is set. I’m checking the supplies now and setting aside anything we can spare, especially anything useful for the fence board or porch step.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great — I’ll help track down the time and see if we need any extra tools or parts for the fence board and porch step.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sunday at the community center, right? If you hear any update from Uli on tools or parts still needed, pass it along and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Right — I’ll pass along anything I hear. Gus has the toolbox, and the others are already helping with supplies, timing, and getting the word out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll keep Sunday at the community center on my list, and I’ll watch for any update on tools or parts needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds like we still need spare parts and a few more volunteers—do you know if Ira has updated the list yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard an update from Ira yet, but Eli’s still putting the list together. It sounds like we may still need a few tools and volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Right, so it’s still not locked in yet. If you hear back from Ira, let me know—we’ll need those spare parts and a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m checking one last detail, then I’ll set the repair drive time. Rosa should send the tools and parts list soon, too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just let me know once the time’s locked in, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah — I’ll confirm the time as soon as I’m done checking.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an eye on the spare parts while I’m out and check what’s still needed. If I hear anything new, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Ira—Sunday at the community center is the plan, and I’ll make sure the word keeps moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye out while I’m running errands and let you know if I spot anything we still need. Sunday at the community center sounds good to me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll spread the word to the other parents and bring a few supplies. Sounds like they still need some spare parts and extra hands too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Bo — I’ve got my toolbox, tools, and basic supplies ready. Once Leo confirms the time, I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, Gus — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep nudging the other parents and see what extra parts we can round up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — that cracked step by the porch is a good one to check today. I still have that loose fence board on my list too, so we’re getting there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll check the cracked step by the porch today. Once Leo confirms the time, I’ll lock in the repair-drive details and match up what Gus and the others are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Rey — I’ll keep the loose fence board on my end and wait on the final details. Once Leo and Vik settle the list, we should be just about set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Faye — if you can line up a few volunteers and spread the word to the other parents, we’ll be in good shape for 4:30. I’ll also have you and Gus compare notes so we can fill the gaps faster.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to the other parents and start lining up a few volunteers. We still need tools, spare parts, and a few extra hands, so I’ll keep an eye on that too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that really helps. Let’s keep checking on the spare parts and extra hands, and I’ll have you and Gus compare notes later so we can close the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the timing and what we need to bring. Once Rosa sends the list, I can help check the last details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — I’ll send you the list with the final time and needed items. Leo, Rey, Cleo, and Dane are all covering their parts, so we’re in good shape for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — once I have the list, I’ll double-check the timing and what to bring. Sunday at the community center sounds fine, and I’ll keep an eye out for your message.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s picking up nicely, and we’ve got a good turnout so far. I’m going to start by reaching out to folks on Maple Street, since we still need spare parts and a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll check the spare parts and see who’s free to help today, then we can lock in the final time and place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Sam — that’ll help a lot. Ira’s checking the list too, and we’re still aiming for about 4:30 after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on the final time and place. Once Ira confirms what’s left, we’ll know if anything else needs lining up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So we still need the final time and place confirmed, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that’s right — the time and place still aren’t confirmed yet. Ira’s checking what’s left, and we still need the spare parts count and volunteer count sorted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m on it—I’ll invite a few more neighbors today and keep Uli posted on who can help. Sam’s still leading the first check, so we’ll know what needs fixing soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn. I’m still confirming the repair drive location and whether we need any extra tools or parts before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—once you confirm the spot and tools, I’ll pass it along right away and keep rallying a few more neighbors for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We still need Rey’s update on the cracked step, then I can lock the final schedule and list. Faye’s good with 4:30 after pickup, and Gus has the basics covered.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll check the spare parts and see who’s available, then we can lock in the final time and place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — that would help. Once Rey’s update comes in, I can lock the final schedule and list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need spare parts and enough volunteers before it’s locked in. Do you know if we’re short on tools too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check on the volunteers and whether we’re short on any tools or parts. I also know Mara’s aiming for late afternoon after pickup, around 4:30, so families can stop by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, please check that. If we’re still short on tools or parts, I’ll keep asking around for help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’m still waiting on the timing and supplies list, but I’ve got a few people helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds about right — I think Leo and Pia are still sorting the time and what to bring. Let me know if you hear anything on parts or the volunteer count.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do — I’ll pass along any word on parts or volunteers as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply check covered and I’ll set aside anything we can spare for the fence board and porch step. Thanks for keeping the rest of the list moving, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’ll keep nudging the remaining list, and the loose fence board is still the main one I’m watching.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good — I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we can spare, and I’ll let you know if I find something useful for that fence board.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m going to start spreading the word today and invite a few more neighbors for the repair drive. I’ll let Uli know who can help once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’ll keep spreading the word too, and we still need spare parts and a few more volunteers for about 4:30 after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep inviting neighbors right away and let Uli know who can help. I’ll also mention we still need spare parts and a few more volunteers for 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still asking around about the timing and what supplies we should bring, and I’ll pass along anything I hear. Rosa’s keeping track of requests, so I’ll make sure you get the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I joined a bit late, but I can help confirm the time, location, and any tools or parts we need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane — that’d be a big help. I’ve got Sunday at the community center so far, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear about the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’m still sorting the timing and what we should bring, so I’ll wait for your confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’m checking one or two details now and will confirm the time as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’ll wait for your confirmation before I plan anything else.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still set for Sunday at the community center. Dane is confirming the time and location, and we’re still checking whether any tools or parts are needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes — we still need a few tools, some spare parts, and a couple more volunteers. Once Leo confirms the time, we’ll match what Gus and the others are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds right — once Leo confirms the time, I’ll keep the community center details straight and match them with what Gus, Sam, and the others are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s picking up nicely, but I still hear they need tools, spare parts, and a few more volunteers. I’m still waiting to hear the exact time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, that matches what I’ve got — there are still a few tasks left, and I can pass the list along to everyone. I’ll keep an ear out for the exact time and place too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep passing along what I hear, especially if Eli’s list changes or Quinn gets more neighbors on board.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping track of what we still need. If you hear of any extra tools or parts, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out for any spare parts and let you know if I hear of extra tools. I’m also still waiting on the volunteer count.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — I’ll keep track of the volunteer count too. If you get an update, just send it over and I’ll fold it into the final list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m running errands now, and I’ll keep an eye out for the spare parts and what’s still needed. I’ll also listen for any updates on the repair drive and the volunteer count.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds right—can you confirm what’s still missing after your errands? We still need tools, spare parts, and a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll check what’s still missing after my errands and keep an eye out for the tools, spare parts, and any extra hands we still need.
